description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of bias percentages across different contact scenarios and categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Sports,” “Positive Contact Before,” “Healthcare,” and “Negative Contact Before,” while the vertical axis, labeled “Bias Percentage,” employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick labels at 10-unit intervals. The chart features stacked bars for each category, representing three sub-categories: “No Contact Before” (light gray), “Positive Contact Before” (red), and “Negative Contact Before” (blue). For the “Sports” category, the “No Contact Before” portion reaches a value of 45.42, the “Positive Contact Before” portion reaches 7.45, and the “Negative Contact Before” portion reaches 8.31. The “Positive Contact Before” category shows values of 38.08 for “No Contact Before,” 35.38 for “Positive Contact Before,” and 0.01 for “Negative Contact Before.” The “Healthcare” category displays values of 40.79 for “No Contact Before,” 40.70 for “Positive Contact Before,” and 0.11 for “Negative Contact Before.” The bars are not sorted in any apparent order. The tallest bar is in the “Healthcare” category, reaching a total height of approximately 46.73, while the shortest bar is in the “Positive Contact Before” category, reaching a total height of approximately 38.08.
